name: Enthalpy v0.4.10
notes:
# Enthalpy v0.4.10

## Fixed

- Windows: opening an existing vault shows the sign-in form on that screen
  (email and password).
- Linux x64 AppImage launches with bundled graphics libraries. The missing
  libEGL.so.1 error is resolved.

## Preview limits

- Hosted Sync remains available only to the approved owner account on macOS
  Apple Silicon and Windows x64.
- Use only disposable test data until the independent protocol and cryptographic
  review is complete.
- Account creation stays invite-only with a hard one-account limit.
